data.body:
Landed as Gerrit change 1690 (merged 2026-08-13T00:09:59Z), commit 'Count marker records, not the token in prose'. LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 before submit.

Fix: the marker counters now match the EMITTED RECORD rather than the bare token. Real markers are
'<TOKEN> {json}' at the start of the journal message (voter.py prints 'VOTER_ERROR ' +
json.dumps(record) to stderr; autodeploy.sh marker() emits the same shape), and journalctl -o cat
prints the message alone, so the pattern is '^<TOKEN> \{'. That keeps every genuine marker — the
ticket's own evidence, 221 line-start == 221 real against 222 counted by substring — and excludes
prose whether it names the token mid-sentence (the 23:02:26Z line) or opens a line with it.

Applied to voter_errors (S4), review_bot_merge_change_errors (S4c), deploy_errors (S4d) and all four
review-drain counters (S4e; the anchor sits at the call sites because the helper's first argument is
an ERE the reason-scoped counters extend). AUTODEPLOY_* audited and anchored too: that journal is not
LLM-written but autodeploy.sh capture_bot_logs echoes captured review-bot output into it, which is why
that function redacts the token — the anchor makes the counter robust independently.

Deliberately NOT anchored, with the reasoning recorded at each site: replication_errors (S3, Gerrit's
replication_log) and g2p_dispatch_errors (S4b, the Gerrit container journal). Neither stream is
LLM-written and both match free-form phrases ('Giving up', '[ERROR]', 'failed to dispatch') inside log
lines rather than line-start records, so an anchor would drop real failures.

Inflated offsets — VERIFIED, no box action needed. The banked false counts (voter 222 against 221
real, merge-change 1 against 0) self-heal on the first probe run after this lands: the anchored total
drops BELOW the persisted offset, the negative delta hits the lost-history clamp from
2dc7-31b7-ecbb-4cd2, which publishes 0 and re-bases the offset to the true count. One run, no manual
correction. Covered by test_offsets_inflated_by_false_counts_self_heal, which asserts exactly that
(offset 2 -> 1 for voter, 1 -> 0 for merge-change, both publishing 0).

Tests: tests/scripts/test_observability_marker_anchor_8c2f.py — the verbatim 23:02:26Z review line
counts 0 on every marker metric; line-start prose with no record counts 0; genuine records count 1
(2 for the rolled-up review_interrupts); a journal holding prose AND real markers publishes exactly
the real ones. RED-verified pre-fix. The pre-existing stub journals in the 1648, 6a65 and cold-start
suites emitted BARE tokens, which are prose under the new pattern, so they now emit records — the
fixtures were not reproducing the emitters.

Deploy: no manual box action — autodeploy.sh watches OBS_PATHS and re-runs install-observability.sh.

Self-referential firings during landing: the review of change 1690 itself discussed this vocabulary,
so any voter/merge-change alarm firing before the probe picked up this commit is the same false
positive (see the triage note above), not a real failure.
